title: Maximum Total Subarray Value I
summary: Given an integer array nums of length n and an integer k, select exactly k non-empty subarrays.
statement: Given an integer array nums of length n and an integer k, select exactly k non-empty subarrays. Each subarray's value is the difference between its maximum and minimum elements. The total value is the sum of these subarray values. Find the maximum possible total value.
constraints: Choose exactly k nonempty subarrays; the same maximal interval may be chosen repeatedly.
A subarray value is its maximum minus minimum.
hints: No subarray can exceed the whole-array maximum minus minimum.
The full span containing both extrema attains that bound.
Because selections may repeat, use that span k times.
Multiplying the global range by k matches the upper bound and construction.
editorial: Multiplying the global range by k matches the upper bound and construction.

tests.explanation: The full array has range two and may be selected twice, totaling four.
The range seven repeated three times gives twenty-one.
